survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This OECD country note summarizes indicators from Education at a Glance 2025 and related OECD surveys (including PIAAC for adult skills). It does not provide an analysis sample, microdata extraction procedure, or any explicit application of student/sampling weights or replicate-weight methods in the note itself. The figures and comparisons are therefore best treated as indicator-level outputs already produced by OECD using the underlying survey designs. For any re-analysis at microdata level, analysts should use the official PIAAC and Education at a Glance indicator methodology and apply the corresponding complex-survey weights (and replicate weights where provided) to obtain population-representative estimates and correct standard errors.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: This document is a descriptive country note that reports indicator results (e.g., attainment shares, unemployment rates, literacy/numeracy score differences) rather than fitting an ML model on PV-based achievement outcomes. Plausible values and missing-data handling are therefore not part of the note’s reported methodology; they are handled upstream in the OECD indicator production and PIAAC scaling/estimation processes. As a result, the note does not specify PV combination rules or missing-data procedures for the reader.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: This is a country note for Germany that reports the latest available indicator values from Education at a Glance 2025 (and PIAAC for adult skills). The note does not define an analytic microdata subsample (e.g., grade band, task module, or case exclusions) and does not report student counts for an analytic dataset.

data.outcome_summary: Education at a Glance 2025 (Germany country note) provides descriptive system-level and adult-skills indicators rather than an original student-level predictive/causal analysis. The note highlights changes in tertiary attainment among 25–34 year-olds, the share of young adults without upper secondary qualifications, and associated skill disparities using OECD Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC) results. It also reports labour-market associations by educational attainment (unemployment rates and earnings differences) and system indicators such as education expenditure per student and teacher/school resource measures. Because the note is indicator-based, it does not specify an ML modeling pipeline, target variable(s) for prediction, or performance metrics. Any PV generation/combination and missing-data handling are part of the underlying OECD survey/scaling production for PIAAC and the Education at a Glance indicators, not described in this country note.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This extraction corresponds to an OECD descriptive country note (indicator summary) rather than an empirical ML paper. Consequently, there is no student-level analytic dataset, no ML algorithms evaluated, no PV-handling or missing-data strategy reported for an analysis model, and no performance metrics to tabulate as findings. Sparse fields (e.g., total_students, countries sample sizes, confounders) are expected because the document is not presenting a new statistical model with an explicit estimation sample.
